algorithms.length_quartiles: statistics.quantiles(sorted lengths, n=4, method='inclusive'); bins are <=q1, <=q2, <=q3, >q3
algorithms.cwe_family: first numeric CWE in cwe_list; families from protocol section 4.5; CWE-190 is memory_buffer by table order; non-numeric or unknown -> other
algorithms.project_isolation: within each task, a project belongs to exactly one split; projects that are multi-sample in that task are test-only. The protocol (§4.2) permits a project to be dev in one task and test in the other; the cross-task intersections are recorded

constraints.cross_task_policy: each task splits its projects independently, as in protocol section 4.2; a project may be dev in one task and test in the other, and the exact intersection is listed under project_isolation.cross_task

detection.selection: compact one-line out-of-bounds read on an empty base name; memory_buffer family
compact and self-contained, with no unsafe memory operations; length quartile 1
clear use-after-free when an IO object is copied onto itself; lifetime family
compact, no allocation or buffer writes; length quartile 2

repair.selection: single-buffer-size fix in an otherwise identical function; memory_buffer family
single-condition short-read check in an otherwise identical function; input_validation family

project_isolation.rule: within each task, a project belongs to exactly one split

cross_task.note: protocol section 4.2 splits each task independently; these projects are dev in one task and test in the other and are listed for audit
